elements_selected.content: Refactor server.py to use the new session module instead of in-process globals. (1) Import session module. (2) In search_chunks_contextual: load shared state at entry, use session.get_surfaced_penalty() for resurfacing, pass embed_query as the embed_fn for circling detection, call session.record_surfaced() and session.record_query() after assembly, save state before return. (3) Remove the old global _session_surfaced and _session_queries dicts. (4) Remove the old record_surfaced(), record_query(), get_surfaced_penalty(), detect_circling_topics() functions from server.py. (5) Keep the comment block (lines 372-380) explaining the architecture — update it to describe the shared state solution. (6) search_chunks (flat path) remains unchanged — no session tracking on flat searches.
